name: draw in proportion to score
mechanism: choose members at random with probability proportional to their score, so better members are chosen more often but none is excluded

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Fitness proportionate selection' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: also known as roulette-wheel selection
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Stochastic universal sampling':

fails_when: a dominant member takes over; scale of scores changes pressure
